description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grant [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Cosmic Warrior Mode I (Wol)], [Twin Element Mode II (Earth, Holy)] and [(Earth/Holy) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Cosmic Warrior Mode I (Wol)
description.text: Earth and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth and Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Earth and Holy abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Earth or Holy abilities

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Earth, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Earth/Holy ability

description.name: (Earth/Holy) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Earth and Holy abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Cosmic Warrior Mode II (Wol)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Cosmic Warrior Mode I (Wol)] from the user
